question: The position of earth in its orbit when it is at its greatest distance from the Sun is called:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aphelion**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The position of the Earth in its orbit when it is at its greatest distance from the Sun is called **Aphelion**.
 
• Aphelion occurs once a year, typically around early July.
 
• During Aphelion, the Earth is about 152.1 million kilometers (94.5 million miles) away from the Sun.
